THEOREM If a is a real number, then a + 0 = a.
PROOF If x is in a and y is in 0, then y < 0, so x + y < x. This implies that x + y is in a.
Thus every member of a + 0 is also a member of a.
On the other hand, if x is in a, then there is a rational number y in a such that
y > x. Since x = y + (x — y), where y is in a, and x — y < 0 (so that x — y is
in 0), this shows that x is in a + 0. Thus every member of a is also a member
of a + 0. |
